facts.business: Ipca Laboratories Limited manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products including bulk drugs, generic formulations, and APIs across domestic and international markets.
key_risks: Poor public healthcare funding and infrastructure
Low per capita consumption of medicines in emerging economies including India
Geo-political conflicts and resultant increase in energy and logistics costs
Inflation and resultant all round increase in input costs
facts.related_party_note: Loans given to associates and joint ventures: Krebs Biochemicals & Industries Ltd. (Associate) Rs 12.80 crore, Lyka Labs Ltd. (Joint Venture) Rs 5.00 crore, and other non-related corporate body Rs 9.25 crore during FY2025-26. Investment in Lyka Labs Ltd. share warrants converted into equity shares Rs 36.27 crore in FY2024-25.
